description: The single definition of the capture presets. docs/05-qa.md, templates/QA.md and the scripts derive every number from this file; do not restate the values in prose or in test code.

contract.frame_count_rule: frame_count = fps x duration_seconds, and must be a whole number
contract.range_rule: image index range is start_number inclusive to start_number + frame_count exclusive
contract.frame_count_field: not allowed in a preset; the frame count is derived, so a second authoritative value cannot exist
contract.edit_rule: change a preset here and the plan, the inspection and the documentation follow; never hand-edit a number in the docs
